The City hosts Household Hazardous Waste drop-off events on the second consecutive Friday and Saturday of each
month. To schedule an appointment, call (805) 987-0717 or visit cityofcamarillo.org/hhw to select from the available
appointment times and read the program guidelines.
ACCEPTED ITEMS: aerosols, antifreeze, gasoline, asbestos*, batteries-household & auto, electronics &
E-waste, fire extinguishers, fluorescent light bulbs & tubes, household chemicals and cleaners,
medication (unwanted or expired pharmaceuticals), motor oil & oil filters, sharps & needles,
paint - latex & oil based, pesticides & fertilizers, propane tanks.
ITEMS NOT ACCEPTED: Explosives, radioactive materials, ammunition, compressed gas
cylinders (helium or oxygen), garbage, cardboard or trash, MAPP gas cylinders, tires, biological
waste, marine flares, smoke detectors.
